rows.label: US dollars per pound sterling, 2019 annual average

source.title: Bank of England, Statistical Interactive Database, series XUAAUSS (annual average spot exchange rate, US$ into sterling)

rows.explainer: The average of the Bank of England's daily spot rates over 2019. Models that import a cost stated in pounds for a year's spending convert it to dollars at that year's average, so every model on the site counts per dollar.

rows.label: US dollars per British pound, 2024 yearly average

source.title: US Internal Revenue Service, Yearly average currency exchange rates
source.note: Table row United Kingdom (Pound), column 2024: 0.783 pounds per dollar; 1 / 0.783 = 1.277 dollars per pound.

rows.explainer: Used to turn costs that Founders Pledge's 2025 recommendation pages state in pounds (written for its UK members) into dollars. The 2024 average is the latest full year before those pages.
